propositions: The deprecated env var REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from the resolver and all prose sites describing it as live, leaving only the config key [tool.rebar.llm].model intact.
A still-set REBAR_LLM_MODEL must fail loud with RemovedInputError and a migration message rather than being silently ignored, to prevent silent model changes affecting cost and quality.
The deprecation registry row for REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be deleted from _deprecations.py and replaced with a tombstone entry matching the REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS precedent.
All 15 test files setting REBAR_LLM_MODEL and building LLMConfig must be retargeted to use the config table, per-class env vars, or CLI override to avoid raising RemovedInputError.
The model resolution chain must become CLI > [tool.rebar.llm].model > DEFAULT_MODEL with no env channel, and per-class precedence must be CLI > per-class env > config table > built-in default.

Documentation and operator-facing material (docs/config.md, infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md, infra/compose/docker-compose.yml) must be updated from 'deprecated' to 'removed' and regenerated env-vars.md must not list the variable.
